newsitem.title: UK: Mass murderers' son pleads to teachers on abuse.
newsitem.headline: Mass murderers' son pleads to teachers on abuse.

text.p: The eldest son of mass murderers Fred and Rosemary West on Wednesday urged teachers to be far more vigilant in watching out for signs of child abuse.

"The teachers should be trained in identifying abuse. On one occasion when my mother almost strangled me I had finger marks around my neck and I had to say I'd been messing around with a rope," Stephen West told BBC Television.
In a programme being aired on child abuse, the 23-year-old West said: "We went to school black and blue some days and nobody saw it. They accepted all the excuses we gave them."
"I was told from a very early age that if I spoke about anything that went on inside the front door I'd be killed."
Rosemary West was sentenced to life imprisonment last November for her part in murdering 10 women and girls.

Nine bodies were dug up at the family home, dubbed the House of Horrors by the press, that Rosemary shared with her husband Fred in Gloucester, western England. He confessed to killing 12 women but hanged himself in jail before he could be tried.
